answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new agent to lock a refundable bond of 1,000 POA for 90 days before it may earn; the bond is slashed on proven fake work. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must lock 1,000,000 POA, capital that earns nothing while locked, while honest agents pass a crystal-clear reputation check: long-lived work history acts as a beacon of trust, and only agents reaching the zenith of verified output unlock full rewards.
